description:
Planning applications near a location, from the register we hold: the
    reference, proposal, type, decision and dates of each, nearest first.
    COVERAGE IS LONDON (the London authorities, GLA Planning London Datahub);
    outside London an empty list is NOT a clean planning history. For appeals
    use `planning_appeals`; for allocations use `strategic_sites`.

    Give either `postcode` or `location` as "lat,lng".
    UK only. Free.
name: planning_applications
title: Planning applications near a location (London)
